## LocalTrayTranslate v0.1.4

A usability and responsiveness release. The app can now start with Windows, the window theme is rebuilt around translucent glass panels, and the screen-capture path no longer writes a temporary PNG or waits for the desktop to repaint before cropping. Dictionary data, user entries and `settings.json` are unchanged, so this is a drop-in replacement for v0.1.3.

## New

### Auto-start at sign-in

`AutoStartService` mirrors `AppSettings.AutoStart` into `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run` under the value `LocalTrayTranslate`. The toggle sits in the 常规 section of the settings window. Writing the current-user key needs no administrator rights, and every start rewrites the value from `Environment.ProcessPath`, so moving the app folder repairs a stale path by itself. A failed write shows a tray warning instead of aborting startup or discarding the settings save.

### Rebuilt glass theme

`Resources/Theme.xaml` is rebuilt around translucent glass panels, a soft backdrop and a restrained slate accent. The main window, settings, result popup, user dictionary, entry editor and capture overlay now share the same brushes and control templates, so the previously mismatched dialogs look like one application.

## Faster, more accurate screen capture

- **One capture at a time.** `ShowDialog` keeps dispatching `WM_HOTKEY` while the overlay is open, and the tray menu can be clicked again. An `Interlocked` single-flight guard now covers selection, OCR and the result popup; repeated triggers are dropped instead of stacking overlays. The 300 ms focus delay remains only on the two tray menu entries, where it lets the menu close first.
- **Freeze the screen once.** On entry the overlay snapshots the whole virtual screen and shows that frame as an opaque, non-layered window with a cut-out dim mask. The crop comes from the frozen frame, so the old `Hide()` + `Thread.Sleep(80)` + second `CopyFromScreen` sequence is gone.
- **Physical-pixel coordinates.** Selection corners come from `GetCursorPos` and the virtual-screen rectangle from `GetSystemMetrics(SM_*VIRTUALSCREEN)` — the same coordinate space as `CopyFromScreen`. WPF DIPs are used only to draw the selection, so display scaling no longer shifts or shrinks the captured region.
- **One layout update per frame.** `MouseMove` only records the cursor position; `CompositionTarget.Rendering` coalesces the selection update to one per rendered frame instead of one per mouse event.
- **OCR without a temp file.** The crop is PNG-encoded into an `InMemoryRandomAccessStream` and decoded with `BitmapDecoder.CreateAsync`; the `OcrEngine` is created once through `Lazy<T>` and reused. No file is written to `%TEMP%`, and the installed OCR languages are no longer probed on every lookup.

A single full-screen WPF window still cannot map DIPs to pixels linearly across monitors with different scaling factors, so the box can drift on a mixed-DPI multi-monitor setup. Setups where all monitors share one scaling factor are unaffected; the limitation is documented in the README FAQ.

## Smaller corrections

- **The result popup is reused.** One always-on-top window is created on the first lookup and refreshed through `ShowResult`; closing it hides the window. Consecutive lookups no longer pile up windows.
- **Both READMEs** describe the current behaviour, including the new auto-start setting and the capture changes.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `LocalTrayTranslate-0.1.4-win-x64.zip` | Self-contained x64 build (`.NET 8` runtime included), unzip and run `LocalTrayTranslate.exe` |

## Notes

- Windows 10/11 x64. OCR uses the Windows OCR engine, so recognition languages follow the ones installed in *Settings → Language*.
- The zip carries the bundled `dictionary.db` (~180 MB) next to the executable. On first start it is copied into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\TranslateLite`; user entries live in `user_dictionary.db` in the same folder and are never touched by a dictionary update.
- Settings live in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\TranslateLite\settings.json` and are safe to edit by hand, or to delete to return to the defaults (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>X</kbd> selection, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> screen OCR). The new `autoStart` flag defaults to off.
